description: This file defines an interface (abstract class) IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface declares four pure virtual methods for handling various events related to runtime, window, ripple, and state changes, passing JSON data or event names as parameters.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface for event handling, requiring implementation of event response methods.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events, receives JSON data object.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events, receives JSON data object.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events, takes an event name and JSON data.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events, receives JSON data object.
